headline: ETF Rotation Summary: Software and Cloud Lead Market While Defensives Deteriorate
market_regime: Broad Expansion with Internal Sector Divergences
executive_summary: Quantitative ETF rotation metrics reveal persistent leadership in Software (IGV) and Cloud Computing (SKYY), alongside emerging leadership in Metals & Mining (XME) and Telecommunications (IYZ). In contrast, defensive areas including Utilities (XLU) and Food & Beverage (PBJ) are confirmed in ROTATION_OUT states with 63-bar score lows. Material within-sector divergences are present across Technology, Industrials, Health Care, Consumer Discretionary, Communication Services, and Energy. Value continues to lead Growth in style pairs, with IWD holding a confirmed PAIR_LEADING signal versus paired ticker IWF.

emerging_rotations.title: Sweden Emerges in European Equities
emerging_rotations.explanation: EWD holds a confirmed EMERGING state with a rotation score of 75.31, advancing 12.14 points over 5 bars and 27.39 points over 20 bars, supported by positive 20-bar relative strength of 0.64 percentage points and 63-bar relative strength of 1.98 percentage points.

emerging_rotations.title: Telecommunications Demonstrates Emerging Strength
emerging_rotations.explanation: IYZ maintains a confirmed EMERGING state with a score of 69.58, posting a 20-bar score improvement of 40.51 points and 5-bar score change of 3.47 points. Its relative strength is positive at 6.05 percentage points over 20 bars and 0.18 percentage points over 63 bars.

emerging_rotations.title: Metals & Mining Shows Emerging Momentum
emerging_rotations.explanation: XME carries a confirmed EMERGING state with a score of 62.71 and a 20-bar score surge of 49.19 points, despite a 5-bar score change of -7.94 points. Relative strength evidence across horizons is mixed, with 20-bar relative strength at +12.83 percentage points versus 63-bar relative strength at -11.54 percentage points.

accelerating_rotations.title: Ireland Retains Confirmed Acceleration
accelerating_rotations.explanation: EIRL carries a confirmed ACCELERATING state with a score of 66.72 and a 5-bar score gain of 6.11 points, despite a 20-bar score change of -9.38 points. Relative strength evidence is conflicting across horizons, with 20-bar relative strength at -0.21 percentage points and 63-bar relative strength at +9.92 percentage points, while a pending raw NEUTRAL state sits at 2/3 observations.

accelerating_rotations.title: Global Health Care Holds Accelerated Trend
accelerating_rotations.explanation: IXJ reflects a confirmed ACCELERATING state with a score of 63.33, though its 5-bar score change is -6.67 points and 20-bar score change is -13.67 points. Relative strength metrics are split across horizons, showing -0.50 percentage points over 20 bars and +6.73 percentage points over 63 bars, while a raw WEAKENING state is pending confirmation (1/3 observations).

persistent_leaders.title: Software Sustains Top-Tier Leadership
persistent_leaders.explanation: IGV holds a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state with a score of 90.42 (rank 2 in theme group), advancing 6.06 points over 5 bars and 48.56 points over 20 bars.
